_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the HumanitZ egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: HumanitZ
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The isometric open-world zombie survival game for up to 64 players. Installs the Linux dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated.
startup: v=; [ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && v=validate; if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $v +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; exec ./HumanitZServer/Binaries/Linux/HumanitZServer-Linux-Shipping HumanitZServer -log -port={{SERVER_PORT}} -steamservername="{{SERVER_NAME}}"

config.files: {"HumanitZServer/GameServerSettings.ini": {"parser": "ini", "find": {"[Host Settings].ServerName": "{{server.build.env.SERVER_NAME}}", "[Host Settings].Password": "{{server.build.env.PASSWORD}}", "[Host Settings].AdminPass": "{{server.build.env.ADMIN_PASS}}", "[Host Settings].MaxPlayers": "{{server.build.env.MAX_PLAYERS}}", "[Host Settings].SaveName": "{{server.build.env.SAVE_NAME}}", "[World Settings].PVP": "{{server.build.env.PVP}}", "[World Settings].SaveIntervalSec": "{{server.build.env.SAVE_INTERVAL_SEC}}"}}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# HumanitZ. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 2728330) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. Saves and GameServerSettings.ini are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-2728330}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# The server reads HumanitZServer/GameServerSettings.ini. Start it from the
# reference file that comes with the server when there's none; the Panel sets
# the name, passwords, players and save in it at every start.
cfg=HumanitZServer/GameServerSettings.ini
if [ ! -f "$cfg" ] && [ -f HumanitZServer/REF_GameServerSettings.ini ]; then
    cp HumanitZServer/REF_GameServerSettings.ini "$cfg"
    echo "Made GameServerSettings.ini."
fi
chmod +x HumanitZServer/Binaries/Linux/HumanitZServer-Linux-Shipping
echo "Installed HumanitZ build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser; avoid the word Official.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password players type after /AdminAccess in chat to become admins, or empty for none.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Save
variables.description: The save to load, or create when there's none by that name.

variables.name: PvP
variables.description: true lets players hurt each other and use each other's cars and containers; false turns that off.

variables.name: Save interval
variables.description: How often the world is saved, in seconds; 0 turns autosave off.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install; linuxbranch is the Linux server. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
